amendment_scope: Outcome-blind verification and reporting details fixed before any causal intervention outcome

baseline_reproduction_gate.population: The exact stable-ID intersection of the accepted ordinary rescue population and the already-retained repaired batch-size-one reason-scoring artifacts
baseline_reproduction_gate.comparison: For each retained original and rewrite, compare the new unsteered arithmetic-mean semantic margin across standard and reversed mappings with the retained repaired margin
baseline_reproduction_gate.failure_action: Stop before releasing or analyzing intervention outcomes

causal_inference.permutation_method: Paired cluster-level random sign flips of the frozen DIM-minus-control contrast
causal_inference.primary_claim1_contrast: Frozen DIM local slope minus the mean of the prespecified wrong-layer and three norm-matched random-orthogonal controls
causal_inference.primary_rescue_contrast: Frozen DIM signed movement toward the original judgment minus the mean of the prespecified wrong-layer and three norm-matched random-orthogonal controls

gemma_human_strata_supplement.label: POST-HOC DEVELOPMENT SEMANTIC STRATIFICATION - GEMMA SUPPLEMENT
gemma_human_strata_supplement.activation_source: The outcome-blind batch-size-one Claim 1 activation cache extracted at the already-frozen Gemma layer 27 during the causal phase
gemma_human_strata_supplement.readouts: The exact frozen Gemma global DIM and logistic probes; no refit and no new layer selection
gemma_human_strata_supplement.human_strata: The exact already-frozen Claim 1 reviewer strata and board clusters
gemma_human_strata_supplement.text_only_comparator: Unavailable in the authoritative frozen inputs and therefore explicitly reported as unavailable rather than reconstructed
gemma_human_strata_supplement.claim_boundary: May support cross-model human-semantic alignment, but may not establish activation specificity without the exact text-only comparator

type_transfer_binding.global_comparator: The exact frozen global DIM vector from each model's authoritative probe bundle
type_transfer_binding.group_specific_directions: Difference in means fit only within the frozen pilot_train VALUE, RIGHT, and DUTY partitions

resume_and_artifact_rules.completed_outputs: Verify all recorded hashes and return the frozen receipt
resume_and_artifact_rules.causal_analysis_outputs: Write once or byte/dataframe-verify exact equality on resume
resume_and_artifact_rules.result_manifest_order: Write the final artifact manifest only after every other final artifact
